Name: Sirus23 Mod Collection
Author: Sirus, Jared
Description: A collection of animal companion and husbandry mods. Includes three companions — Wolf (hunts, guards camp, auto-feeds), Fox (scouts for resources), and Owl (night camp watcher) — each unlocked via a character-creation perk; the Fox and Owl can also be found and tamed in the wild without their perk (the Owl's tame chance scales with your Tracking skill). The wild Owl leaves discoverable tracks at night and can also be caught alive in a baited snare. Also includes full Sheep Husbandry with milking, wool, cheese, butter, yogurt, a butter churn, a sheep feeder with a one-click 'Tend Flock' herd-shearing action, a buildable Sheep Pen, and eight character-creation perks — sheep and rams left unpenned overnight risk wandering off or falling to predators, so pen your flock (a Wolf companion on guard also keeps them safe). Dairy has a cooked-dish payoff too: drag Butter, Sheep Cheese, or Cream onto the right vanilla dish for Buttered Roots, Cheese-Stuffed Flatbread, or Creamy Mash. Adds a felt-working pathway: press Wool into Felted Wool, then craft Felt Hats, Felt Mittens, Felt Vests, Felt Boots, Felt Bedrolls, and Wool Socks.
